Hi Joe / Sarah 1

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and agreed next steps from our discovery call so the broader implementation team has visibility: 

Summary of needs / pain:
- Strict data residency requirements: PHI and patient-identifiable data must remain in your VPC region (US-east).
- Network constraints: only outbound TLS to specific egress IPs is allowed; no inbound public IPs; strict firewall rules and proxy requirements.
- Air-gap option: legal team asked about an air-gapped on-prem variant for pilot sites with no external connectivity.
- Audit & controls: SOC 2 type II evidence, audit logs retention (7 years preferred), and KMS/HSM for key management.

Goals we heard:
1) Proof-of-concept inside AcmeHealth VPC to validate latency & throughput for 10 concurrent agents.
2) Security review to sign off on architecture and controls (security team to provide questionnaire).
3) Timeline: POC within 6 weeks, production rollout phased after security sign-off.

Technical notes we captured:
- Preferred deployment: Private (customer-managed VPC) with dedicated subnets and NAT egress through Acme-managed firewall.
- If an air-gapped pilot is required, we'll provide an on-prem package and a deterministic install script; some features (auto-updates/metrics) are limited in fully air-gapped mode.
- We recommend the quantized model profile for cost/latency trade-offs; our runtime supports KV cache warmup and deterministic kernel selection for your GPU profile.

Agreed next steps:
- Acme security to send the standard questionnaire and any additional compliance checklists (Joe).
- Marissa/Dev to share architecture diagram & SOC2 summary (attached).
- Schedule follow-up technical deep-dive with infra/networking + security (propose Jul 31 or Aug 3).
- Identify pilot site and point-of-contact for on-prem testing (Sarah).

Attachments included: redwood-private-vpc-architecture.png, soc2-summary.pdf

If I missed anything, flag it and I will update. Otherwise I can put a calendar invite for Jul 31 11:00 ET for the technical deep-dive.

Thanks,

Thanks Joe 1 appreciate the quick turnaround. Quick answers inline: 

- Egress IPs: we'll provide a stable set of egress IPs and a change-policy doc. For Dedicated/Private we can offer a static NAT egress pool; for on-prem air-gap there are no egress IPs.
- Telemetry for air-gapped install: minimal local metrics are available in file form; nothing is transmitted externally unless you opt-in to send aggregated metrics. We'll include an install-time flag to disable outbound telemetry.
- KMS/HSM: yes, we support AWS KMS integration and have a BYO-HSM flow for on-prem using PKCS#11-compatible modules. We'll include configuration notes in the architecture doc.

I'll attach the egress IP list and change policy doc ahead of the technical deep-dive. Putting a calendar invite on Jul 31 11:00 ET now.
